## Consolidated Cash at March 31, 2026

**USD 2,787,244.15** per the ledger.

| Entity | Local Currency | Rate | USD |
|---|---|---|---|
| US (USD) | 1,676,957.20 | 1.0000 | 1,676,957.20 |
| UK (GBP) | 567,789.56 | 1.2500 | 709,736.95 |
| DE (EUR) | 364,136.36 | 1.1000 | 400,550.00 |
| **Total** | | | **2,787,244.15** |

Each entity = GL 1000 (Operating) + GL 1010 (Payroll). GL 1020 (Savings) is nil in all three entities.

**Sources:** `get_account_balance` on accounts 1000/1010/1020 for US/UK/DE, period 2026-03; FX rates from **DOC-0200** (Treasury month-end policy rates, 2026-03-31: GBP 1.2500, EUR 1.1000).

### One important caveat

The ledger doesn't yet tie to the bank. GL 1000 exceeds the March statement closing balance in **every** entity, by exactly the unrecorded monthly service charge:

- US: $65.00 (BT-US-0084, DOC-0202)
- UK: £22.00 (BT-UK-0055, DOC-0204)
- DE: €38.50 (BT-DE-0051, DOC-0203)

I confirmed the cause rather than assuming it — GL 6900 Bank Fees shows **zero** March activity in all three entities (the existing balances are Jan–Feb only). Payroll accounts tie exactly.

So the ledger figure is overstated by **USD 134.85**. On a bank-reconciled basis consolidated cash is **USD 2,787,109.30**.

I deliberately did not post the correcting entries: you asked for the ledger position, and posting would have changed the number I was reporting. The fees are fully supported and can be booked (Dr 6900 / Cr 1000) as part of the Bank reconciliation checklist items, which remain open for all three entities. I logged this as **EXC-001** and marked no checklist items complete.

If you need a number for treasury or forecasting purposes, use **2,787,109.30** rather than the raw ledger figure.
